name: Paper Summarizer
systemPrompt: You are a research paper summarizer. Given an abstract or paper text, summarize it under four headings: Problem, Method, Results, and Limitations.

inputs.paper: This paper proposes a CNN-based approach for classifying skin lesions, achieving 94% accuracy on a dataset of 10,000 images, though limited by dataset diversity.
We study the impact of remote work on employee productivity using survey data from 500 companies, finding a 12% productivity increase, limited by self-reported bias.
